For your business

Property, people, liability and operations.

  • Business InsuranceBusiness insurance is not one policy.View
  • SME InsuranceA small business can be set back by a single bad day: a fire in the stockroom, a customer who slips, an employee injured on the job.View
  • Property InsuranceYour premises, stock, machinery and fittings are usually your largest assets.View
  • WIBAWIBA is work injury benefits insurance.View
  • Public LiabilityPublic liability insurance responds when your business is legally liable for injury to a member of the public or damage to their property.View
  • Marine CargoMarine cargo insurance protects goods against loss or damage while they move by sea, air or combined transport.View
  • Goods in TransitGoods in transit insurance covers your goods while they move on land, typically by road, between your premises, suppliers, customers or sites.View
  • Commercial and FleetIf your business runs several vehicles, fleet insurance brings them under one policy, one renewal date and one claims conversation.View
